line_items.reasoning: Q1-2025 revenues came in at $21.6B, putting the company on a ~$86B+ annualized pace, above the $83.5B–$84.5B full-year 2025 guidance range, driven by strong Markets (+12%), Wealth (+24%), and Banking (+12%) performance.

Q1-2025 ROTCE of 9.1% is tracking below the lowered 2026 target of 10%–11%, but this is a single quarter early in the year and management reaffirmed guidance, so no clear deviation from the multi-year target can be declared yet.

Positive operating leverage was delivered firm-wide and across all 5 business lines in Q1, with M&A expenses declining 5% YoY, directly exceeding the guidance of positive operating leverage every year and tracking toward the sub-60% efficiency ratio target.

NII ex-Markets appears to be tracking ahead of the guided 'up modestly (~2%–3%)' for 2025, supported by strong loan/deposit volume growth and portfolio repricing, though card credit losses and Retail Services revenue declines represent partial offsets as guided.

Expenses are expected to tick up in Q2 per management commentary, and the Banamex transformation continues to require investment, but full-year expense guidance of slightly below $53.8B was reaffirmed with no indication of a material overshoot in Q1.
